goal_claim_rule: NEVER CLAIMABLE: this Goal is a planning container only. Builders claim one contained sub-goal.

boundary_rules: Customer Care owns customer-facing complaint recovery, expectation continuity, repeat-contact prevention, retention and rebooking after a customer relationship/service interaction exists.
Operational Exception Resolution owns operational exception mechanics; Customer Care may request/verify remediation but does not redefine or re-parent that Specialist.

Customer Access owns customer-entry/access outcomes; Sales owns commercial opportunity progression; Scheduling/Dispatch owns fulfilment; Field owns field quality; Finance owns cash controls; Marketing owns review/referral growth.
Channels, case queues, sentiment models, review platforms and CRM records are tools/state, not separate agent identities.
Customer Lifecycle Experience Orchestrator owns cross-domain lifecycle/retention coherence; it does not replace Customer Journey Access, Revenue Growth or Service Delivery Flow Orchestrators.

agent_goal_rule: This goal owns durable business/domain outcomes and may reuse, extend or create canonical workforce identities subject to non-duplication and outcome-owner tests.
workforce_goal_rule: Agents are permitted only for durable business/operational outcomes with a distinct ownership boundary. Reuse or extend canonical identities before creating new ones.
